chapter: Buddy Petit and brass band reading
title: Photos of Paul Barnes, Kid Thomas and Louis Nelson
summary: Looking at photos, they identify Paul Barnes and Kid Thomas; Ridgley says Barnes never made it back and had clarinet trouble.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Who were the great clarinetists? Favorites and rivals

blocks.x: Here's a picture. That's Paul Barnes.
Can you see Lewis Nelson there, that trombone player?
I've seen him in the street, but I never did know him. You never did know him. No, but I still know him. Lately I've met him in the street. I recognize him there. Who is that?
That banjo player? No, right there. Trumpet player? That's Kid Thomas from across the river. Oh, I see. Paul Barnes. He never did come back. He didn't make it so good.

He never did come back. He didn't make it so good. Bonds is back here. I knew he did. Yeah, but he seems to have trouble with his clarinet playing. He can't play it like he… I know he's not doing what he thinks he can do. Yeah. He got himself rated a little above. He tried to come back and get me to set up a bunch of guards, but I didn't want to do it the same time.
